subject: Billing channel authorization and invoice issuer decision
messages:
From: Grant Foley <g.foley@betarobotics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@beta-robotics.com>
Date: 2026-12-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick question on invoice originator + delivery

Hi Connor,

We're finalizing the PO and need to confirm a couple of billing mechanics before we punch this in our AP system:

1) Which entity will appear as the invoice issuer (legal name) — Redwood Inference or a billing agent?
2) Can invoices be pushed to our portal (ap@beta-robotics.com) via SFTP/EDIFACT, or do you deliver PDFs to an email inbox?

We have a PO reference (attached) and need VAT evidence for EU purchases, but for this contract we'll be US-only. Can you advise the recommended path so we set the PO correctly?

Thanks — please cc your billing contact.

Best,
Grant Foley
Finance Manager | Beta Robotics
[attachment: Beta_Robotics_PO_4321.pdf]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Grant Foley <g.foley@betarobotics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-14T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice originator + delivery

Grant — thanks for the PO and the clear questions. Looping in Kimberly (billing ops) and Hannah (AP onboarding) to confirm options. High level:

- Legal issuer: Redwood Inference, Inc. (we can provide a PDF of our certificate if you need one on file).
- Delivery: two supported flows — (A) push to customer portal / SFTP (preferred for automated AP) or (B) email PDF to an AP inbox.

Kimberly / Hannah — can you confirm the technical + timing details for SFTP push and whether we need a separate billing contact in Beta for file acknowledgements? Also, Hannah — can you confirm whether we should embed the PO number in the invoice reference and the exact invoice XML schema Beta prefers (sample attached).

Connor
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Grant Foley <g.foley@betarobotics.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-14T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice originator + delivery

Grant — quick answers and next steps: 

- Invoice issuer: Redwood Inference, Inc. (TIN: 12-3456789). We will list your PO ref in the Invoice-Ref field.
- Delivery options:
  • SFTP push: we can push a compressed batch (daily) to a vendor SFTP with an ack file. Requires SFTP endpoint, username, and an ingestion schedule.
  • Email PDF: we can send a single PDF per invoice to ap@beta-robotics.com and include invoice XML in the attachment if you want structured data.

Action items for Beta to pick one of the following (so we can provision):
  1) Provide SFTP details + PGP key for file encryption (recommended for automated AP).
  2) Confirm email recipient and whether a mailbox rule will auto-ingest PDF/XML.

I've attached our sample invoice XML and a short onboarding checklist. If you'd like, we can start with email delivery for the first two invoices and transition to SFTP after cutover.

Attachments: sample-invoice.xml, onboarding-checklist.pdf

—Kimberly
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Grant Foley <g.foley@betarobotics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@beta-robotics.com>
Date: 2026-12-14T13:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice originator + delivery

Thanks Kimberly — we prefer SFTP for automation, but two notes from AP: 

- Our SFTP is managed by a central vendor. They need a sample payload and our account name to whitelist. I uploaded the PO and will share the vendor contact if you need direct handoff.
- For legal: our procurement team needs the issuer exactly as on the invoice PDF (Redwood Inference, Inc.) and they require a scanned certificate of incorporation for their vendor file.

I can route the SFTP contact details (and PGP key) — would prefer you kick off email delivery for the first invoice while we finalize the SFTP onboarding. Also, VAT evidence is not required for US-only spend but please include tax breakdown fields (0% tax).

Will send SFTP vendor contact in a follow-up.

—Grant

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Grant Foley <g.foley@betarobotics.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-15T14:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice originator + delivery

Grant — thanks, that works. Short plan and timeline: 

1) This week: Kimberly will send the first invoice as a PDF + embedded invoice XML to ap@beta-robotics.com so your team can ingest immediately.
2) Next week (target): SFTP handoff. Please send the vendor SFTP contact + PGP public key to kimberly@redwood.com. We'll schedule a one-hour cutover call (AP vendor, your procurement, and our billing ops).
3) Documents: Connor, I'll upload a scanned certificate of incorporation and a short vendor attestation to the HubSpot company record (link below).

Open items:
- Grant to confirm the account name to whitelist with your SFTP vendor.
- Connor to confirm whether our invoice sequence should include a prefix for this customer (we usually do RB-INV-).

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/67890

I'll handle the first-send and confirm delivery. Thanks all.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
AP Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
[attachment: sample-invoice.xml]
